payload.claim: The spec declares no `risk:` field (defaults to `standard`, `declared_risk` is `None`), even though `saffron/cell/worktree.py` is in `touches` and matches `policy.yaml`'s `elevate_on` entry `saffron/cell/**`, which will auto-elevate the diff to `elevated` at build time per DESIGN.md regardless of the frontmatter. This is harmless for the `size` gate itself (the measured 457-token diff is far under the 4200-token `refactor` ceiling either way), but `tasks.risk` (the ledger's pre-declared tier) will read `standard` for this task, unlike sibling spec `SA-0400` in the same batch, which touches the same `saffron/cell/**` tree and does declare `risk: elevated` explicitly. An operator should decide whether `SA-0399` should likewise declare `risk: elevated` for consistent queue treatment and visibility, even though nothing here would cause a wrong build.
